title: John Peterson's 1998 Arlington Institute meeting on extraterrestrials living among us

tellings.quote: we're doing a little get together uh of a mini conference to discuss what it's what it would be like in a world where extraterrestrials are openly acknowledged as living among us.

plain: In 1998, John Peterson, head of the Arlington Institute, a think tank, is said to have invited people to a small private conference about what the world would be like if extraterrestrials were openly acknowledged as living among us. The UFO historian Richard Dolan relays this as told by Katherine Austin Fitz, who was invited. If true, it would suggest some insiders were planning for open contact.
